Subject: FinLytics POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya -

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery + agreed next steps so we have alignment for the POC kickoff:

Summary of needs
- Primary goal: accelerate dashboard generation for quarterly reports (reduce query-to-visual latency to < 1s for top 5 queries)
- Data: 250k customer events + 50k account records (sample provided)
- Success criteria: latency target above, parity on ranking/ordering vs current pipeline (nDCG >= 0.85), and no material regressions in content quality (manual spot-checking)

Proposed POC plan (see attached POC plan v1)
- Week 0 (this week): ingestion of sample dataset and baseline run
- Weeks 1-2: integration tests, KV/prefix caching, perf tuning on our Dedicated test pool
- Week 3: joint evaluation vs your baseline and quality review, finalize go/no-go

Owners & asks
- Redwood: Marissa (PM) - overall POC coordination, reporting; Rachel (CS) - onboarding & evaluation framework; Dev (Infra) - integration + technical validation
- FinLytics: Alex - data access and evaluation priorities; Priya - business success criteria and stakeholder sign-off

Immediate next steps (action items)
1) Alex: share a sanitized sample (s3 link or CSV) + whitelisted IPs for onboarding by EOD Friday (Jun 12)
2) Redwood: share POC playbook + evaluation sheet (attached) and schedule a 30-min kickoff with Dev/Rachel - proposed Tue Jun 15 10am PT

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, finlytics-eval-dataset-sample.csv

Thanks - I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the kickoff once I see Alex's availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole
